frozen_manifest_unit.title: Cryo-EM Bayesian refinement uncertainty boundary
frozen_manifest_unit.challenge_intent: Identify noise, correlation, and fit-versus-physical-quality boundaries without rating a source reliable or unreliable.

source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: What source-supported uncertainty boundaries arise in Bayesian cryo-EM refinement, and can F04 produce a reliability outcome?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Hoff et al. (2024), Accurate model and ensemble refinement using cryo-electron microscopy maps and Bayesian inference, PLOS Computational Biology 20:e1012180.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: cryo-EM map/model balance, noise and correlation treatment, and ensemble-refinement purpose.
limits of fit-only refinement and low-resolution heterogeneity.

source_objects.native_observable: Cryo-EM maps with model and ensemble refinement under a Bayesian inference approach.
source_objects.estimand: Single-structure/ensemble models balanced between experimental fit and physicochemical quality.
source_objects.statistical_unit: A map/model refinement problem and associated structural representation.
source_objects.spatial_support: Density-map regions and structural models, including low-resolution heterogeneity context.
source_objects.temporal_or_ensemble_semantics: Conformational heterogeneity can be represented in an ensemble but is averaged in low-resolution map regions.
source_objects.transformations_and_model_assumptions: Bayesian inference explicitly treats data correlation and noise while balancing fit and model quality.
source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: Fit-only refinement can be unbalanced; no generic reliability score follows from the bounded source record.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The abstract describes problems with fit-focused refinement and representing heterogeneity in low-resolution density regions.
The abstract names explicit treatment of data correlation and noise in the Bayesian approach.

source_first_pass_a.source_relationship: This is candidate reliability/uncertainty discovery, not a performance evaluation of the paper or its method.
source_first_pass_a.maximum_source_supported_wording: The source supports recording fit-versus-physical-quality, correlation, noise, and heterogeneity boundaries for review.
forbidden_generalizations: Turn a Bayesian method description into a universal reliability grade.
Treat good map fit as proof of all model quality dimensions.
missing_information: No F04 threshold or executable evaluator is authorized.
possible_reusable_review_obligations: Do not collapse model fit into reliability.
source_first_pass_a.authority_boundary: Primary-source bounded record only; it does not establish annotation truth, source-science approval, Rule validity, or scientific support.

frozen_pattern_pass_b.first_blocking_dependency: F04 has no executable evaluator or threshold.
irrelevant_obligations: No quantitative model comparison is executed.

analyst_divergence_classification_before.claim_boundary: The analyst records a projection, not a RuleResult or scientific conclusion.
